notes.title: Steam Trading Cards and Items
notes.content:
Good day!
We hasten to please you, now our game has trading cards that you can sell or buy or craft an badges! It sounds incredible, but Steam gave us all this approval. We also added backgrounds for the Steam profile and a couple of emojis.

Steam items will appear after the publication of this post.

notes.title: Stream with the developer
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38660045/0d3251d4bd7c8f4c729933c673cca21cbe3eb8d9.png[/img]

In this broadcast, one of the developers will be playing the game Hero of Not Our Time. Please sit back and enjoy the game from one of the leading developers!

notes.title: The Steam Awards
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38660045/fecf5a7b51f7d165e810dbfe63ffe3c96b13f768.png[/img]
The voting phase of the nominees for The Steam Awards 2020 has begun on Steam.
You can vote for our game by nominating it for Best Soundtrack or any other.
We've really gone to great lengths to write a cool soundtrack for the game, and would be very happy if you vote for Best Soundtrack.
Good game!

Hide Head Team

notes.title: Game Update
Hero of Not Our Time is out now!
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=sbB34TrwrRc;full][/previewyoutube]

We greet you!

Hide Head team is pleased to inform you that [b]Hero of Not Our Time[/b] is out!
We thank you for your patience, and we hope that you will appreciate the aesthetics of ultraviolence that you will create in the game's locations.
We wish you a pleasant game!

Yours faithfully,
Hide Head Team
